modmenu.descriptionTranslation.signed_pa: Keeps Signed Paintings images cached on disk between sessions, with quality, LOD and memory options.
signed_paintings_cache.title: Signed Paintings Cache
signed_paintings_cache.option.disk_cache: Save downloaded paintings to disk so they load instantly next session instead of being downloaded again.
signed_paintings_cache.option.cache_size: Maximum disk space for cached paintings. When full, the least recently seen paintings are removed first.
signed_paintings_cache.option.max_age.to: How old a cached painting can get before the mod checks its server for a newer version. 'Never' means cached paintings are used forever (use /paintings:reload to update one).
signed_paintings_cache.option.revalidate: When re-checking, ask the server whether the image changed instead of downloading it again. Most image hosts answer with a tiny 'unchanged' response.
signed_paintings_cache.option.retry_fail: Wait this long before trying a broken or unreachable image again. Stops dead links from being re-requested over and over.
signed_paintings_cache.option.parallel_d: How many paintings can download at once. Lower values smooth out joining busy areas on slow connections.
signed_paintings_cache.option.max_downlo: Images bigger than this are refused, protecting you from huge files that freeze the game.
signed_paintings_cache.option.max_resolu: Shrinks images bigger than this when they load, to save RAM/VRAM. Original keeps every painting pixel-identical to what its placer sees (recommended unless you're low on memory).
signed_paintings_cache.option.filter.too: Only used when an image is over Max resolution. Auto: pixel art and pixelated images keep an exact pixel grid, photos are shrunk smoothly. Pixels-per-block on signs always uses Signed Paintings' own resizing, so deliberate pixelation is never altered.
signed_paintings_cache.option.hard_edges: When a photo is shrunk smoothly, keep images that only have fully opaque or fully clear pixels that way, so they stay on the cheaper cutout render path.
signed_paintings_cache.option.texture_de: Scales every painting texture (using Signed Paintings' own blocky resizing). Lower values save VRAM on low-end GPUs but change how paintings look.
signed_paintings_cache.option.max_textur: Caps each painting's texture size, including ones with a high pixels-per-block setting.
signed_paintings_cache.option.reuse_base: Don't create enlarged copies of small images; draw the original instead. Looks the same in-game and uses far less VRAM for pixel art.
How long a painting you can't see keeps its GPU texture. Longer = no re-upload hitch when you look back, but more VRAM.
signed_paintings_cache.option.ram_keep.t: How long an unseen painting stays in memory. After that it's reloaded from the disk cache (not the web) when needed.
